purpose: Defines the overall system design of doc-link: system boundary, operations and their connections, the high-level sequence of ToC building and impact notification, and common invariants.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks and change-impact notification
Write boundary: only the DLID may be written into target documents, and only by the explicit DLID assignment operation
Table of operations with inputs, results handed on, and write boundaries
ToC build order: target fixing, ID check, change detection, info acquisition, reference check, candidate check, commit
Search and DLID resolution are separate operations performed after the ToC is committed
Overall sequence diagram of index-docs and check-impact in the normal case
Unreadable reference target directories are recorded as absent and do not block commit
Common invariants: ID independence, real directory scan, no partial candidate exposure, no notification state, per-key isolation
Items left to individual designs: storage as JSON files and cross-key visibility of the same ID
tasks: Designing or reviewing doc-link overall architecture
Checking the write boundary of doc-link on user documents
Implementing ToC build, search, DLID resolution or impact notification operations
Understanding how index-docs and check-impact connect
title: DES-001 システム全体設計
